shape_notes.kv_cache_size: The cache is allocated at the session's real 41215 blocks (2.70 GB) and each sequence is given a shuffled, non-contiguous page set, so the kernel sees the address spread it sees in production rather than one tight contiguous range.
shape_notes.topk_idx: Generated deterministically per query: block ids drawn from the causally visible range [0, ceil((prefix+i+1)/128)), always including the local block (sparse_local_block=1), sorted ascending and right-padded with -1.
